files.policies.yml:
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: CAP-M
    type: cap
    title: food per month
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
  - id: CAP-Q
    type: cap
    title: food per quarter
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: quarter}
    limit: {value: 300}
  - id: ROUT-M
    type: routine
    title: monthly transfer to savings
    match: {tags: transfer, account: savings}
    period: month
  - id: FLOOR-H
    type: floor
    title: cash floor
    measure: {holdings: class.cash}
    limit: {value: 1000}
